review: 605.3c-1: the no_other_source variant was illegal only because A had no mana at all (an unpayable cost), not because of 605.3c; Initiates of the Ebon Hand nets zero mana so re-entry changes nothing. Dropped the scenario and skipped 605.3c with that reason.

605.4a-1: variant manabarbs said the illegal cast still tapped Forest and dealt 1 damage to A; an illegal cast taps nothing. Removed the damage and set polarity does_not_fire (same outcome as no_flare, not a third branch).

skipped.reason: no Forge card makes the restriction observable: every mana ability whose cost is mana alone (no tap or sacrifice) produces no more mana than it costs, so a forbidden nested activation would leave the same mana pool and board as a legal one

scenarios.title: A mana ability can be activated in the middle of casting a spell, other abilities cannot

setup.notes: Llanowar Elves and Prodigal Sorcerer have been under A's control since before this turn.

decisions: A begins casting Grizzly Bears and reaches the step of paying its {1}{G} cost.
While paying, A activates Llanowar Elves's mana ability for {G} and taps Forest for {1}.
Both players pass; Grizzly Bears resolves.

variants.label: mana_ability
variants.expected: Activating Llanowar Elves's mana ability during the payment is legal; Grizzly Bears is cast and enters the battlefield.

variants.label: non_mana_ability
variants.delta: During the payment A tries to activate Prodigal Sorcerer's damage ability targeting B instead of Llanowar Elves's mana ability.
variants.expected: Activating Prodigal Sorcerer's ability while casting a spell is illegal; Prodigal Sorcerer stays untapped and B takes no damage.

scenarios.title: An activated mana ability does not use the stack and cannot be responded to

setup.notes: B holds Stifle with an untapped Island.

decisions: A activates Llanowar Elves's ability, tapping it for {G}.
B, if given priority with the ability on the stack, casts Stifle targeting it; otherwise B passes.
Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: mana_ability
variants.expected: Llanowar Elves's ability never goes on the stack, B gets no priority and Stifle has no legal target; {G} is in A's mana pool at once.

variants.label: damage_ability
variants.delta: A activates Prodigal Sorcerer's ability targeting B instead (and B responds with Stifle, tapping Island).
variants.expected: Prodigal Sorcerer's ability goes on the stack and Stifle counters it; B takes no damage and Stifle moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A triggered mana ability resolves at once and its mana can pay for the spell being cast

setup.notes: Mana Flare: whenever a player taps a land for mana, that player adds one additional mana of any type that land produced. A has no other mana sources.

decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears and pays its {1}{G} cost by tapping Forest for {G}.
Mana Flare's triggered mana ability adds another {G} immediately, also used for the cost.
Both players pass; Grizzly Bears resolves.

variants.label: mana_flare
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is legal (can_play true) with the single Forest; it enters the battlefield and Mana Flare's trigger never uses the stack.

variants.label: no_flare
variants.delta: Mana Flare is absent from the battlefield.
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is illegal (can_play false): one Forest produces only {G}.

variants.label: manabarbs
variants.delta: Manabarbs is on the battlefield instead of Mana Flare.
variants.expected: Casting Grizzly Bears is illegal (can_play false): Manabarbs's trigger is not a mana ability and adds no mana, so one Forest produces only {G}.
